ops.title: Backup
ops.neverBackedUp: No backup yet. Press “Back up now”.
ops.lastFailed: The backup on {{when}} failed: {{reason}} Tula tries again after 10 minutes and at the next daily time.
ops.savedLocalOnly: Could not reach {{folder}}, so the backup was saved on this computer only. Connect the drive, or choose another folder below.
ops.folderMissing: The backup folder {{folder}} cannot be reached right now. Connect the USB drive or check Google Drive.
ops.restoreFailed: The last restore did not happen and your data was not changed: {{reason}}
ops.folderTip: Tip: choose a folder inside Google Drive (for example C:\Users\Shop\My Drive\Tula backups) so every backup is also kept safe in the cloud.
ops.folderTipUsb: Or a USB drive (for example E:\Tula backups). Leave empty to keep backups on this computer only.
ops.sameDisk: This folder is on the same disk as Tula's data. If the disk fails, both are lost. Choose Google Drive or a USB drive.
ops.dailyTimeTip: Pick a time when this computer is usually on, such as an hour before closing. If it was off, Tula backs up when it starts next.
ops.restoreNeedsService: Restore from here works when Tula runs as the installed service. Otherwise follow “Restore” in the install guide.
ops.restorePoint1: All bills and changes made after this backup will be replaced by the backup.
ops.restorePoint2: Tula first saves a copy of today's data, so nothing is lost for good.
ops.restorePoint3: Tula restarts. Everyone, on every phone, signs in again.
ops.restartingText: Tula is restarting with the backup. This page opens again by itself in a minute.
ops.restartingSlow: This is taking longer than usual. Check the Tula computer is on, then reload this page.
